title: Nazi memorabilia at Paperclip facilities
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Nazi memorabilia at Paperclip facilities, about late 1940s at White Sands and Holloman, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Swastikas and Nazi memorabilia were reportedly on open display in some of these facilities.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the late 1940s, when the United States brought German scientists to work for it after the Second World War, an effort known as Operation Paperclip. He says that swastikas and other Nazi items were reportedly on open display at some of the facilities where they worked, such as Fort Bliss and White Sands, military sites in Texas and New Mexico. He tells it to show how openly these men's past was tolerated in the early American rocket and space work.
